title: Abu Dhabi AOD spikes vs IAG.L
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Abu Dhabi CAMS AOD 20d z-score > 1.5 marks dust or smoke episodes that cut Gulf flight volumes (-); trade short IAG.L 2d at 1d lag [airquality.abu_dhabi.cams_aod -> finance.IAG.L.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.abu_dhabi.cams_aod rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short IAG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
